page: Microsoft Azure D192ds_v6 is a massive general-purpose virtual machine built on Intel Xeon 8573C processors operating at up to 4.2 GHz. Using the x86_64 architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 96 physical cores and 192 dedicated vCPUs with simultaneous multithreading. It provides 768 GB of system memory, matching the standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio characteristic of Azure general-purpose tiers. Storage includes 11,340 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, alongside hardware support for advanced vector and matrix acceleration instructions including AVX-512 and AMX.

Benchmark evaluation highlights exceptional multi-threaded scaling and memory throughput across intensive workloads. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU testing (159,457.54) and Geekbench multi-core execution (20,726.0), complemented by 511.98 GB/sec uncached large-block read memory bandwidth and 213.85 GB/sec write bandwidth. While single-threaded performance registers in the average to upper quartile, parallelized tasks such as Clang compilation, bzip3 decompression, and database transactions show leading efficiency. The presence of AMX instructions also enables competent CPU-based LLM token generation and prompt processing without specialized accelerator hardware.

The D192ds_v6 represents a high-density compute and storage profile suitable for consolidating massive parallel workloads on a single node. The inclusion of 11.3 TB of fast local NVMe storage provides a cost-effective operational advantage for applications requiring low-latency scratch space or caching without recurring networked disk transaction penalties. Best-fit deployments include enterprise relational and distributed databases, large Redis caching instances, intensive CI/CD compilation pipelines, high-throughput static web infrastructure, and large-scale data engineering jobs.
description: Microsoft Azure D192ds_v6 is a high-capacity general-purpose virtual machine powered by 96-core Intel Xeon 8573C processors delivering 192 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of RAM. Designed for heavy multi-threaded processing, it integrates 11,340 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports advanced Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets. Benchmark performance demonstrates leading tier multi-core execution, over 511 GB/sec uncached memory read bandwidth, and 211.88 million Redis operations per second. While single-thread rates are moderate, the dense core count and bundled high-speed local disk eliminate networked storage overhead for high-IOPS applications. The D192ds_v6 is well suited for large database deployments, in-memory caches, distributed build pipelines, and high-concurrency enterprise workloads.
